name: Fixed billing
description: Billed amount should be same as per contract

name: Audit of Top 5 HFS each month
description: Fuel analyst will conduct the audit of top 05 high fueling sites at the end of every month and share the action plan and way forward with MS Vendor to reduce the fuel on these sites along with cost & control team in loop.

name: Collection of Bills
description: All bills will be uploaded on EHBRT within 1 day of receiving by MS vendor CP analyst
responsible: MS Vendor CP Analyst / Regional Compliance

name: Fuel reconciliation
description: At the end of each month fuel will be reconciled on the basis of RMS/EAS alarms. MS Vendor Fuel analyst acknowledge the quantity of dispersion and uplift as per the EOMS fuel dispersion and uplift report respectively. If any modification or deletion of entry required then it should be forward to CMPAK fuel analyst with in first two days of each month along with proper justification and remarks. CMPak Regional fuel analyst review the modification and deletion request and either process/approved and process by DT Team for further execution. NOMC cost & Control Team will forward/approved the changes to DT POCs. The modification process should be completed in first 3 working days of a month with SM ticket raised to OSS DT teams. After correction/modification in fuel dispersion report a proper reconciliation must be done by regional fuel analyst on the basis of RMS/EAS. Each site refueling quantity, standard DG consumption and RMS/EAS DG alarm will be taken of complete month. Fueling as per alarm and DG consumption will be calculated and compare it with the actual fueling.

name: Conduct Monthly Security Review Meeting
description: Hold monthly meeting and share open/closed theft statistics with management and HQ.

name: MDV record
description: Regional fuel analyst is responsible to keep the updated record of mobile DG vans (as per the format mentioned in annexures) and share it with NOMC Fuel analyst on monthly basis for fuel reconciliation.

name: Distribute Key Keeper Salary & Share Tracker
description: keeper salary before 5th of every month & tracker to be shared with HQ security POC

name: Comply with Core Location Maintenance Checklist
description: Ensure compliance with maintenance checklist and frequencies defined by CMPak.

name: Asset return Target/achievement
description: Weekly/Monthly targets for return of the faulty/damaged inventory available in vendor's warehouses.

name: FSR Random verification
description: CMPAK will randomly re-verify the FSR/register and if found any error or fake information in fuel quantity, DG hour meter reading, signatures missing of guard/engineer/field team.

name: 7 step process for chronic owner/guards
description: A comprehensive 7-step process has been devised by NOMC to identify the root cause and steps to resolve the chronic fuel issues at very earliest. For details, security management policy to be reviewed. Regional teams are to follow the process in its true letter & spirit.

name: Submit Battery Discharge Report
description: Submit site-wise battery discharge reports after health check.

name: On site Fuel log
description: All fuel dispersion on site must be recorded on fueling log book available on site by MS Vendor.

name: Monthly Collection of Bill
description: ABS invoice shall be collected by MS vendor CP analyst from the concerned DISCO printed on DISCO letter-head, along with the reference#-wise hard and soft copies of the bill.

name: Conduct 10% Sample Site Audit
description: CMPak regional team shall audit 10% sample sites in each sub-region/grid.

name: Warehouse equipment Audit
description: Quarterly audit of all the MS vendor warehouses is required to be carried out by regional teams (Utility & Compliance team or any other POC nominated by RCTO) for confirmation of availability / utilization of spares.

name: Approve SLA Breach Exemption for Civil Work
description: For any force majeure or access issues due to law-and-order situation or local community issues, exemption can be granted to vendor after getting approval from relevant FOPS Manager, NC Manager and RCTO.

name: Fuel Cannes Calibration
description: In case of fueling through canes, it will be ensured to use calibrated 30 liters transparent white canes. These canes should be approved from regional management.

name: Report Theft Incidents
description: Prepare and submit theft reports for all theft cases.

name: Close Security Cases
description: Close theft/security issues and document resolution.

name: Submit Core Txn PM Checklist
description: Ensure all PM checklist fields are completed and submitted to NOMC.

name: Audit Site Logbooks
description: Conduct planned and surprise audits of site logbooks and SLA compliance.

name: Perform Radiator Descaling
description: Carry out radiator descaling annually or as required.

name: Monthly Security Meeting
description: CMPak RSO to conduct monthly meeting in presence of Regional Manager FOPs

name: Submit Security Action Plan
description: Submit action plan within five days of ticket initiation.

name: Telco issuance monthly reconciliation
description: Every month, regional team (Assistant Manager Utility & Compliance Management) will carry out reconciliations with MS vendor for the telco inventory issued to the vendors.

name: Submit Monthly PM Plan
description: Prepare and share preventive maintenance plan every month.

name: Fixed fuel sites
description: Regional fuel analyst to ensure lodging of all sites in EOMS 7-step theft resolution process.

name: Submit Monthly PM Analysis
description: Submit PM analysis highlighting delays, deviations and site-wise PM execution.

name: Fuel entities audit and report weekly
description: Grid lead , Fuel analyst and RSO will audit MDV,Fuel vehicles , Fuel stations monthly with 50%,25%,15% responsibility respectively. Scanned copies of audit forms are to be provided to NOMC along with the audit reports in excel sheet (already shared with regional teams). Space on shared access network (SAN) drive has been taken from IT teams upon which scanned copies of all audit forms should be placed on regional basis in every quarter. Fuel analyst must supervise the audit plan of all fueling entities i.e., Fueling vehicle, Fueling stations (pumps) and mobile DG vans. If any ambiguity or gap found that report will be share with the MS Vendor fuel analyst for further investigation and decision as per existing MS Contract. Fueling vehicle inspection format is available in supporting documents. Feedback as per the excel based format & the scanned copies of complete audit forms to be provided to NOMC fuel analyst on weekly basis.

name: Submit Monthly CM Consumables Report
description: Provide detailed site-wise report of consumables and spare parts repaired or replaced.

name: Perform Battery Health Check
description: Conduct quarterly discharge test and battery health assessment.

name: Annual fuel benchmark
description: MS Vendor shall be responsible to benchmark fuel consumption of all DG sites annually. CMPak regional teams to take up the matter with MS teams to conduct the activity annually.

name: EAS rectification
description: External alarm power plot verification daily and its rectification in 2 days

name: SOH of battery recording and evidence keeping
description: Region to check SOH on monthly basis. Region shall maintain SOH of battery & must furnish on demand.

name: Reconcile Spares Availability/Utilization with MS Vendor
description: Regional teams are required to carry out detailed inspection every month & take up the matter with concerned department for urgent movement of assets back to warehouses.

name: ABS payment approval and Revision in ABS
description: Regional CP analyst will keep record of excessive billing with Application evidence for correction of ABS to DISCO and monitor correction in coming cycle. RCTO approval to proceed for ABS payment with reason/hinderance in correction

name: Submit PM Forms (Annex-C)
description: Submit completed Annex-C preventive maintenance forms to CMPak.

name: Fueling Team structure
description: Fueling team shall consist of three members, fuel supervisor who led the fueling activity, fuel helper who assist the fuel supervisor and vehicle driver. Regional teams has to ensure this team structure nationwide.

name: CDR Matching
description: CDR of fueling TTs closure should match with the site where fuel dispersion done which means fueling team should close fuel dispersion ticket on site.

name: Register Fuel Teams in EOMS
description: MS Vendor will provide the names of fueling teams to CMPAK that will be registered on OSS DB (EOMS).

name: Audit Refueling Vehicles
description: Conduct random audits of vendor refueling vehicles.

name: Submit Lube Oil Procurement Proof
description: Provide manufacturer purchase proof for all lube oil purchases.

name: Submit PM Pre/Post Pictures
description: Submit PM pre/post maintenance photographs including equipment and consumables within 7 days.

name: Fuel Station Selection
description: Following CFT will be responsible for selection of fuel stations. RESPONSIBILITY Regional fuel analyst (Managed services vendor) Regional fuel analyst (CMPak) Regional security officer (CMPak). Following points must be ensured for fuel station selection: Availability of card swiping facility, Ease of access, Fuel storage capacity, Fuel availability for CMPak in case of any emergency, Performing liter test & sharing the fuel station selection form within 3 days of temporary fuel station definition so that it could be permanent defined. RCTO approval is must

name: Monthly DG database update
description: On Monthly basis, the non-operational rental/portable DG should be removed after generating deletion tickets.

name: Recon of fuel penalties for UAC
description: For reconciliation of fueling penalties via UAC, it should be ensured that monthly fuel reconciliation of concerned region must be signed off and completed till 10th of each month.

name: Audit of current year BB installed sites
description: Monthly tracker of current year BB installed sites audit visits progress shall be shared with NOMC HQ along-with audit forms to be uploaded on SAN drives. Managers shall conduct audits on 5% of sites annually.

name: Audit forms submission
description: All the audit reports (signed by regional management – as mentioned in the audit form) should be submitted to NOMC fuel analyst (through email / uploading on SAN drive / pen drive etc – mechanism specified by NOMC fuel analyst).

name: Comply with Inventory Management Process
description: Follow CMPak inventory processes and support quarterly/biannual audits.

name: S2S Battery Bank approval
description: The re-location/ re-installation of swapped Battery Bank along with its serial numbers will be approved by the concerned FOPs Manager & Regional CTO

name: Submit Monthly Core Txn PM Plan
description: Share Core Transmission site visit and PM plan at the start of each month.

name: Fuel dispersion TT closure on monthly basis
description: Regional fuel analyst to ensure the closing of fuel dispersion tickets immediately after fueling activity. At the maximum, fuel dispersion tickets to be closed within 8 hours of fueling activity on site.

name: Warehouse General Audit
description: General audit of the MS vendor's WHs should be carried out on quarterly basis by regional teams (Utility & Compliance team or any other POC nominated by RCTO) as per the below format and should be submitted to NOMC POC.

name: Equipped fueling
description: Its responsibility of vendor to provide fully equipped vehicles (Fuel tanks + Nozzles + Fuel Pipe + Motors + Motor Wire Etc.) to CMPAK. In few area (remote locations) fueling through canes can be carried out but the canes should be clearly calibrated & approved from CMPak regional management.

name: Conduct Joint Theft Site Visits
description: Conduct joint site visits with vendor for theft/problematic sites.

name: Benchmark DG Fuel Consumption
description: Benchmark DG fuel consumption across all sites.

name: Fuel Invoice Verification
description: Regional fuel analyst will verify the invoice, the invoice liters, card numbers, fuel rate (PKR) & other relevant details.RCTO approval is required. MS Vendor shall ensure timely reconciliation of fuel (within first 2 days of next month for previous month) on monthly basis so that no LPS is charged to CMPAK.
